regime_context: The detector shows Gold Miners leading China A-shares with strong durability (0.91) and trend health, but its one validated edge (the absolute-trend gate) did NOT hold on this market's history (gate_helps=false) and the backtest verdict explicitly labels this as experimental/display. Cross-sectional rank-IC is ~0, rotation timing is display-only, and the eligible fraction is narrowing (8/22). Given the mean-reverting tape, I am deliberately lean-low.
emerging_watch: Watching whether AI Compute & Optics (515000.SS) can convert its rank-3 position into sustained breadth — currently breadth is only 0.294 and hurst_tag is mean-revert, which is a weak foundation. The watch retires if its breadth rises above 0.5 over two consecutive weeks, confirming a real handoff rather than a one-week attention spike.

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: Industrial Metals (512400.SS) is the highest-ranked SCORABLE theme (rank 2, eligible), so it is the only lean I can actually grade against a proxy ETF. Its trend gate is eligible (true) and durability is moderate (0.72), with healthy breadth (0.846). This is a faint relative-leadership lean on the only tradable, non-crowded eligible theme near the top — not a momentum-extraction call.
evidence: rank 2 / score 1.302 with scorable=true and etf_proxy 512400.SS
theses.dissent: The detector's own verdict says the trend gate does NOT help on this mean-reverting market, so eligibility is not a drawdown shield here — and rank-IC ~0 means the rank itself is just attention, not alpha. Industrial Metals could simply be noise near the top.

falsifier.text: 512400.SS lags the CSI 300 by more than 3% over any 10-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: This is a crowding-caution lean, not a fade: Innovative Pharma & CXO is crowded (crowding_z 1.15, crowded=true) despite mid-table rank and mixed trend health. Per guardrails, crowding only justifies sizing-down/avoidance — never a short — and I express that as an underweight direction on the tradable proxy (159992.SZ).
evidence: durability_bar 0.52 and hurst_tag mixed (no clear trend)
theses.dissent: Crowding has no validated basket-level forward edge — it is coincident texture only, and crowded themes can keep working for extended periods (reflexivity). Underweighting may simply lag the tape.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ outperforms the CSI 300 by more than 4% over any 10-day window before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
